title: Valar Atomics product cards
description: On a white band, a two-half intro over a row of four tall dark picture cards (4px corners; stacked wide cards on phones), each with a mono caps title at the top and a short paragraph lower down. On desktop a spotlight: the first card is lit at rest, the hovered card otherwise, and the others sink under a black veil while the lit picture scales up slightly.
notes: the cards are `dark` scopes (black film with white text) on the band's card colour
the spotlight is pure CSS (:has); phones show every card lit
